_schema_doc: Text trigger rules for auto-dismissing popups and completing simple dialogs the bot gets stuck on. Each rule: match phrase (case-insensitive substring) + response action. Order matters — first match wins. Add rules as new stuck-states are discovered.

_actions_supported.click_at_match: Click the center of where the matched text was found on screen
_actions_supported.click_at: Click at absolute pixel coords relative to Roblox window (params: {x, y})
_actions_supported.click_at_frac: Click at fractional window coords 0.0-1.0 (params: {x, y}) — resolution-independent
_actions_supported.noop: Log the detection but take no action (for phrases we can't do anything about)

_dismissal_strategy: Do NOT use ESC — it opens Roblox's system menu which is worse than most popups. Preferred dismiss actions: (a) click_at_match on the specific button text (X, Close, OK), (b) click_at_frac to click a safe spot outside the dialog, (c) press a movement key (W) which dismisses many UI overlays.
_notes: Fractional coords for click_at_frac: (0.9, 0.85) = bottom-right area, typically outside dialogs. Adjust if it clicks something bad.
For dialogs with a Close/X button, click_at_match works if the text is exactly 'Close' or 'X'.
Add per-dialog rules as you discover new stuck states in gameplay.
